description: Serves SPARQL queries described in an RDF manifest as named HTTP endpoints for ASP.NET Core, with content negotiation, OpenAPI and MCP.
rules: Install with 'dotnet add package TheODI.NamedQuery --prerelease'; the package is pre-release (0.x) and requires .NET 10.

Supply the endpoint definitions (manifest.ttl and the query files it refers to) as an IFileProvider via options.Definitions in builder.Services.AddNamedQuery(...), e.g. ManifestEmbeddedFileProvider or PhysicalFileProvider, then call app.UseNamedQuery().
Endpoint paths must not collide with the routes the library owns: /, /sparql, /swagger, /openapi.json, /openapi.yaml and /mcp. Don't name a parameter 'format'; it is reserved.
Configure the SPARQL endpoint with NamedQuery:SparqlEndpoint (appsettings.json, environment variable NamedQuery__SparqlEndpoint, or --NamedQuery:SparqlEndpoint=...).
